headline: Nasdaq Announces OMX Stockholm Benchmark Index Rebalancing
summary: Nasdaq announced semi-annual changes to Scandinavian indexes, with Lifco exiting the OMXS30 index to be replaced by an Investor AB portfolio company, alongside ten additions to the broader Stockholm benchmark.
why: Stockholm's OMX index inclusions and exclusions dictate passive capital flows from institutional index-tracking funds.

impacts.name: Lifco AB
impacts.why: Exiting the OMXS30 benchmark index leads to passive fund divestment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Index removals force passive fund managers to sell constituent shares ahead of effective rebalancing dates.
